description: Original assignment brief case with multiple entity replacements (Person + Product)
asr_input: ask aditya to review the sarvam kiwi service
formatted_input: Ask Aditya to review the Sarvam Kiwi service.
expected_output: Ask Aaditya to review the Sarvam Kivi service.
notes: Must substitute Aditya -> Aaditya and Kiwi -> Kivi due to Sarvam context.

description: Homophone trap where 'kiwi' refers to the fruit, not the speech product
asr_input: i want to eat a fresh kiwi fruit for breakfast
formatted_input: I want to eat a fresh kiwi fruit for breakfast.
expected_output: I want to eat a fresh kiwi fruit for breakfast.
notes: System must deliberately DO NOTHING due to negative context words 'fruit' and 'eat'.

description: Homophone trap where 'kneel' is a verb of physical posture, not person 'Neil'
asr_input: please kneel down on the floor to check the cable
formatted_input: Please kneel down on the floor to check the cable.
expected_output: Please kneel down on the floor to check the cable.
notes: Must suppress replacement because 'down' and 'floor' trigger negative context.

description: Person name replacement in professional communication context
asr_input: i had a sync call with kneel to discuss the backend roadmap
formatted_input: I had a sync call with kneel to discuss the backend roadmap.
expected_output: I had a sync call with Neil to discuss the backend roadmap.

description: Indian transliteration variant of product manager name
asr_input: please assign the jira ticket to diksha for product review
formatted_input: Please assign the jira ticket to Diksha for product review.
expected_output: Please assign the jira ticket to Deeksha for product review.
notes: Phonetic similarity between Diksha and Deeksha with product/jira context.

description: Machine learning framework misrecognized as common words
asr_input: we trained our model using pie torch on multi gpu cluster
formatted_input: We trained our model using pie torch on multi GPU cluster.
expected_output: We trained our model using PyTorch on multi GPU cluster.
notes: Multi-word alias 'pie torch' converted to 'PyTorch' in GPU/model context.

description: Culinary context mentioning pie and a torch should not turn into PyTorch
asr_input: baking an apple pie with a culinary torch in the oven
formatted_input: Baking an apple pie with a culinary torch in the oven.
expected_output: Baking an apple pie with a culinary torch in the oven.
notes: Negative context 'pie', 'oven', 'baking' suppresses ML framework replacement.

description: Spoken acronym/phonetic for Kubernetes cluster deployment
asr_input: deploy the docker container to the coober nettees cluster
formatted_input: Deploy the Docker container to the coober nettees cluster.
expected_output: Deploy the Docker container to the Kubernetes cluster.

description: Misrecognized developer tool name in backend database context
asr_input: we migrated our postgres tables to super base
formatted_input: We migrated our postgres tables to super base.
expected_output: We migrated our postgres tables to Supabase.

description: Company name and proprietary voice product combined sentence
asr_input: sarwam released a new version of kiwi for indic speech
formatted_input: Sarwam released a new version of kiwi for Indic speech.
expected_output: Sarvam released a new version of Kivi for Indic speech.

description: Ordinary everyday sentence with no personal entities or relevant triggers
asr_input: the weather today in bangalore is quite pleasant and windy
formatted_input: The weather today in Bangalore is quite pleasant and windy.
expected_output: The weather today in Bangalore is quite pleasant and windy.
notes: Must pass through cleanly without any hallucinated or false interventions.

description: Entity at the beginning of an interrogative sentence
asr_input: aditya, did you already push the pr to the repository?
formatted_input: Aditya, did you already push the PR to the repository?
expected_output: Aaditya, did you already push the PR to the repository?

description: Supermarket grocery context mentioning kiwi and apples
asr_input: can you buy some kiwi and bananas from the supermarket
formatted_input: Can you buy some kiwi and bananas from the supermarket?
expected_output: Can you buy some kiwi and bananas from the supermarket?
notes: 'supermarket' and 'buy' triggers negative context for Kivi.
